title: SB Energy Plans to Start IPO Marketing After SEC Review Finished
description: SB Energy, the SoftBank Group Corp.-backed energy company that’s now building data centers, is preparing to start formally marketing its initial public offering to investors once US regulators are finished reviewing the company’s IPO filing, people familiar with the plan said.

title: India’s Titan On What's Slowing Gold Demand
description: Titan's Managing Director Ajoy Chawla says gold rate volatility, and not the macros has been the biggest challenge for the company in recent times. He said this in an exclusive conversation with BTV's Menaka Doshi. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: The Foxconn of India: Dixon Tech Eyes Growth Beyond Smartphones
description: Sunil Vachani, executive chairman of Dixon Technologies, India's leading electronics manufacturing services company, talks about slow demand for smartphones, production incentives, revenue diversification and China investments in an exclusive conversation with BTV's Menaka Doshi. Vachani also discusses how India can move from assembly to value-added manufacturing. (Source: Bloomberg)
